instrument: CIS Estudio 2998, La defensa nacional y las Fuerzas Armadas (X) (septiembre 2013), P.1: valoración de una serie de profesiones u oficios (escala de 0 a 10)

instructions_translated: To begin, I would like to know how you rate a series of professions or occupations. Using a scale from 0 to 10, please tell me how you rate each of them, bearing in mind that 0 means you rate it “very poorly” and 10 that you rate it “very well”.
